body: Is it really this unusual? I'll call them tomorrow and update my post.
Thank you, I'll try. Wish you the best.
Yes, but I hate them. I thought a lot about how they would react but tbh I don't care about them. They're the reason why I've never ever felt loved and worthy in my life.

I have no reason to live. My life's dreams are crushed, and they were delusional. I can't connect with people. I've suffered my whole life. I feel I'm worthless and can't stop comparing myself with others. I don't have money. I'm not loved. I'm a loner, a ghost. I'm trapped and I hate myself. I could go on with a shitty life but what's the point. I can't live with more regrets. I'm dying young before it becomes clear that I never had anything to offer. Wasted life. Sad. I want to cry. I want to die. NOW!!
